title: Location filter defaults to the user's currently active location only
custom_preconds:
1. Your browser has no remembered settings for this report.
2. You are working in a known active location (the application's location switcher).
custom_steps: 1. Open the report and read the location filter's selection.
custom_expected: 1. The filter defaults to the currently active location only — the default view is scoped to the one location you are working in.
